result: fclose of a reading fopencookie stream calls no seek hook and returns 0 (GitHub #20); a failing seek hook reports its own errno instead of EINVAL

rulings.item: Regular file: the reference leaves the descriptor at the end of the read-ahead at fclose (offset 100 after reading 10 of 100); libniji gives it back (offset 10, POSIX fclose); the brief assumed both resync; no differences row records it
rulings.recommendation: keep POSIX; add a differences row without a compat option (correctness; gnulib's input-stream checks)

rulings.item: fflush whose give-back fails with an errno other than ESPIPE: the reference leaves ferror clear, libniji sets it (s12_4_f_0, POSIX fflush)
rulings.recommendation: keep libniji's; add a differences row

rulings.item: Cookie stream without a seek hook: reference fflush of a reading stream -1 errno unchanged, ftell -1 EIO, fseek -1 errno unchanged; libniji 0, -1 ESPIPE, -1 ESPIPE
rulings.recommendation: keep libniji's (meaningful errno, same as a pipe); add a differences row

informational: fseek(5, SEEK_SET) on a cookie stream: the reference calls seek(0,SET) and reads a block; libniji calls seek(5,SET); same results
errno after a successful fflush of a pipe or ESPIPE cookie: the reference leaves ESPIPE, libniji leaves it unchanged (errno is unspecified on success)
~/bin/probe on the build hosts looks for target/liella/liella-crt1.o; products are target/niji/niji-crt1.o, so every probe rebuilds and never runs (cost two 15-minute waits here)

impact.what: fclose of a read-only fopencookie/funopen stream whose seek hook fails (ESPIPE, EINVAL): -1 EINVAL -> 0, no seek hook call; the same for r+ and after reading to the end
fflush of a reading cookie stream whose seek hook fails with ESPIPE: -1 EINVAL, ferror set -> 0, ferror clear; ftell/fseek report the hook's errno

improvement: fix ~/bin/probe's product paths (target/liella -> target/niji): it silently rebuilds forever, so every agent falls back to hand-compiling probes
